summary: Two lost day hikers — a 28 YOF from the Boulder area and a 23 YOF from Colorado Springs, strangers to each other — met on the Dark Canyon Trail near Horse Ranch Park at dusk on Thursday after both were reported missing; their cars were found parked side by side; they sheltered overnight at an outfitter's camp; Crested Butte SAR found them the next morning tired but unharmed; a helicopter had searched the area overnight without spotting them through tree cover
location: Dark Canyon Trail near Horse Ranch Park, Crested Butte area
responding_agency: Crested Butte Search and Rescue; Mt. Crested Butte Police Department; helicopter
notes: CBN article by Mark Reaman; CBSAR president Randy Felix quoted; cell-ping leads to the West Maroon area/Copper Lake were false leads; date weekday-verified Thursday; RESOLVES the run-150 pending lead
